title: Lair of Tarn Razorlor (miniquest)
start: Recover the diary of Tarn Razorlor. The entrance to Tarn's lair is on the north wall of the ground floor of the Abandoned Mine, accessed via the surface cart tunnel.

recommended.t: Ring of slaying to teleport to the entrance to Tarn's lair

rewards.t: Ability to create enchanted salve amulets, by using Tarn's diary on salve amulets.
Access to terror dogs in Tarn's lair

steps.t: Using a Ring of slaying will teleport the player directly to Tarn's lair, skipping most of the quest.

sub.t: Alternatively, enter level 1 of the abandoned mine by climbing over the mine cart west of the secret entrance and crawling down the cart tunnel.
Head north and enter the entrance. Watch for skeletons and possessed pickaxes.
Navigate the maze, disarm traps along the way or be hit by damage. Watch for skeletons and zombies throughout the maze.

p: A solution to navigating the maze.

steps.t: Kill both Terror dogs, Mutant tarn and Tarn
p: Tarn's bedroom, with his diary on a table

steps.t: Head north through the passageway and take Tarn's diary.

get_inside.text: The entrance to Tarn's Lair is at the northern end of the ground level of the Abandoned Mine.

The fastest way to reach the end of Tarn's Lair is with a ring of slaying, which can be purchased from a Slayer Master or crafted by the player. This teleport allows the player to skip the entire dungeon.
Drakan's medallion will teleport players to Burgh de Rott, where a shortcut over a fence to the west leads to the mine.

Taking the shortcut under the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis and travelling on the swamp boat brings players close to Mort'ton. This shortcut is unlocked as a reward from the Burgh De Rott Ramble minigame.
